tasks.title: Frame size
tasks.solution: 10 header bytes + payload + 2 CRC bytes (+13 signature bytes).

tasks.title: Losses from seq
tasks.solution: (seq_new − seq_old − 1) mod 256 — accounting for the wrap past 255.

tasks.solution: Frame = payload + 12 overhead bytes; multiply by the total rate.
